dispositions.reply: Accepted. The query case reproduces as described: the userinfo pass stops at the first @, which here sits inside the query, so the query pass has nothing left to match. Fix: match each URL once, find the authority end from the original token, and redact the whole token when an @ appears after it.
dispositions.evidence: logger.ts:26-27 applies two replacements in sequence; the reviewer's input reproduces the leak.
dispositions.intended_fix: Single-pass redactUrls with boundaries from the original token; regression rows for an @ in the query and a password holding @.

dispositions.reply: Accepted. The count cap does not bound bytes, and a single key can be as long as the payload. Fix: keep a running byte total while collecting and stop at a fixed budget, counting what is omitted.
dispositions.evidence: JsonNumbers.php:161 caps the number of paths but not their length.
dispositions.intended_fix: Add a PATH_BUDGET constant, stop collecting at the budget, and report the omitted count; regression with one long key.

adjacent_findings.title: Retry queue re-sends a webhook after a permanent 4xx
adjacent_findings.description: The retry job treats every non-2xx response as transient, so a 410 from a removed endpoint is retried until the attempt limit.
adjacent_findings.impact: Wasted deliveries and noisy logs for endpoints that will never accept the payload.
adjacent_findings.next_step: Classify 4xx other than 408 and 429 as permanent and stop retrying.

adjacent_findings.title: Log shipping config still forwards the raw request line
adjacent_findings.description: The shipping config adds the raw request line as a separate field, so redaction in the logger does not cover it.
adjacent_findings.evidence: shipping.yml maps request_line from the HTTP middleware, outside the logger's serialiser.
adjacent_findings.impact: A URL with credentials can still reach the log store through the shipped field.
adjacent_findings.next_step: Drop request_line from the shipped fields or route it through redactUrls.

structured_output.summary: Both active findings are accepted with the fixes described. Two adjacent problems are filed for the inbox.
